title: Turnaround Engineer-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Turnaround Engineer to join Maintenance Solution Department (MSD) under Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME). MSD is responsible for providing specialized and timely maintenance engineering support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities. Your primary role is to provide turnaround management services for refining and petrochemical plants of Saudi Aramco (SA) downstream sector. The services will cover the coordination with SA wholly owned assets, affiliates, affiliates management, OSPAS and other related corporate functions such as Corporate Maintenance Services Department.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist/Lead turnaround assurance review or cold-eye review of turnaround preparation of different facilities in order to have predictable outcome and improvement.
  • Review the progress and quality of the deliverables during the turnaround life cycle and all the phases and provide convincing recommendations for improvements.
  • Work as an influencer and motivate turnaround planning team of different facilities to implement best practices, lessons learned to enhance quality, safety as well as competitiveness.
  • Review implementation of stage-gated turnaround processes in different facilities.
  • Assist/conduct risk management workshop for turnarounds for different facilities.
  • Assist/conduct scope challenge workshop for turnarounds for different facilities.
  • Assist/conduct schedule challenge workshop for turnarounds for different facilities.
  • Assist/review Key Performance Indicators for turnarounds.
  • Keep abreast of significant developments in new technologies which can improve turnaround performances.
  • Lead and run Community of Practice to collect and disseminate the best practices and knowledge between all refining and petrochemical assets.

Qualifications

  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A Mechanical Engineering Degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 12 years experience in Turnaround Management including planning & execution in the Oil & Gas Downstream sector (Refining & Petrochemicals).
  • You will have experience in turnaround planning software such as Prometheus, ROSER, Primavera P6 and any other end-to-end solutions for turnaround and outage management.
  • You will have thorough knowledge and experience in turnaround stage gated concept.
  • Experience in conducting turnaround assurance is preferred.
  • You must have good understanding of competitiveness, and Solomon indices pertaining to turnaround performance.
  • SAP system proficiency is required.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.

You will also support execution of subsea projects. You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams, interacting with Customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.

  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: Field architecture / Flow assurance / System Analysis / Interface Management / Requirement Management / Process engineering / Subsea Production Systems / Risers, flowlines and pipelines / Control systems / Constructability and installation.

  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL .
  • Proven experience deploying solutions on AWS .
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills focused on scalability and reliability.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark.

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil**Job Family Group:**Projects**Worker Type:**Regular**Posting Start Date:**April 7, 2026**Business Unit:**Projects and Technology**Experience Level:**Experienced Professionals**Job Description:****What’s the role**The Orca Development is a Shell-operated ultra-deepwater Flagship Project located in the prolific pre-salt Santos basin offshore Brazil. The field will be developed with 12 subsea wells tied back to a new building Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) unit. The FPSO will be in water depths of 2000m, roughly 200km south of Rio de Janeiro.While Shell is a major producer in Brazil, Orca is critical to extend Shell-operated production into the 2030s. The project will leverage the experience of the FPSO Contractor to supply and operate the FPSO. The FPSO Contractor is one of the foremost suppliers of FPSOs in the world and currently operates more than a dozen FPSOs in Brazil. The FPSO Contractor Detailed Engineering, Procurement and Project Management is centered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, while construction is spread across multiple construction yards in China and Japan, while Installation and Commissioning will be performed offshore Brazil.Orca contracting is focused on the selection of Tier 1 Contractors to maximize delivery confidence for the FPSO, Subsea Hardware (SSHW) and Umbilical Riser & Flowline (URF) contracts. The project employs a lean Owner’s Team with the delivery know-how and commercial acumen to effectively balance “letting the contractor deliver in an area where they are experts” while maintaining expert oversight over critical delivery components of the project to deliver a world class operating asset safely, on time and on budget. Hence, team members must demonstrate the ability to build strong, collaborative relationships with Contractors; to implement scaled assurance processes to manage design and execution risks in a pragmatic way; to adapt Shell processes to industry driven solutions while maintaining system integrity and performance; and to work across system and discipline boundaries for best for project solutions.Accountabilities:* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules across all project phases (initiation to execution and closeout), ensuring alignment with project objectives, stakeholder assessing schedule impacts of change requests, scope variations and risk events.* Drive continuous improvement, enhancing planning tools, methods and project controls maturity.* Interface with project disciplines & contractors to ensure the schedule is fully integrated.**What you bring*** Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than the current employer* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management or a related field* 10+ years of experience in planning/scheduling within complex capital projects, acquired preferably in major oil & gas offshore installation projects* Proven experience in EPCI/EPC, industrial, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure or similar environments* Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (mandatory) and MS (EVM)* Ability to read and interpret engineering documents, procurement plans and construction sequences* Experience with data analytics and reporting tools* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities.* Strong analytical mindset and high attention to detail.* Ability to influence without authority and facilitate cross-functional alignment.* Proactive, adaptable and oriented to solutions.**What we offer**You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.**We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,** **.****Shell in Brazil****Who We Are**Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 85,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.**Our values**At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. title: Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior – Grupo Montreal – Home Office
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior – Grupo Montreal – Home Office

Profissional da CONTRATADA responsável pela produção dos artefatos de software que o Squad deve entregar.

Requisitos e qualificações

Estamos buscando um Cientista de Dados / Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior para liderar a implementação de inteligência artificial em dois pilares críticos da educação mineira: a permanência do aluno e a transparência financeira. Você será o braço técnico para transformar dados em políticas públicas, atuando diretamente em projetos de redução da evasão escolar e na prevenção de fraudes nas movimentações das caixas escolares.

Responsabilidades:

  • Predição de Abandono: Desenvolver e implementar modelos de Machine Learning para calcular a probabilidade de evasão de alunos, permitindo intervenções precoces.
  • Auditoria Inteligente: Criar trilhas de prevenção a fraudes e detecção de anomalias em movimentações financeiras das Caixas Escolares, consumindo dados diretamente via APIs bancárias/internas.
  • Implementação de Ponta a Ponta: Desde a extração e tratamento dos dados no Data Lake até o deploy dos modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Cultura de Dados: Traduzir insights complexos em dashboards e relatórios para gestores públicos que não possuem background técnico.
  • Documentar as soluções desenvolvidas e apoiar no monitoramento, controle de erros e sustentação.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior completa (tecnólogo, graduação e/ou pós-graduação lato sensu e/ou pós-graduação stricto sensu) na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Histórico comprovado em projetos de Ciência de Dados, preferencialmente com foco em detecção de fraudes, anomalias ou análise de risco financeiro.
  • Domínio avançado de Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM) e SQL avançado.
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Fabric e Azure Machine Learning (Notebooks, Synapse, MLflow).
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs REST e integração de dados de diferentes fontes.
  • Capacidade de entender a dor do negócio (educação/gestão pública) e propor a melhor solução técnica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia no setor público ou em Fintechs/Auditoria.
  • Pós-graduação em IA/Machine Learning.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps para monitoramento de modelos.

title: AI QA Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Sobre a 1STi

A 1STi é uma empresa de tecnologia que desenvolve soluções inovadoras com foco em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a problemas reais de negócio .

Atuamos em projetos que combinam engenharia de software, dados e IA , incluindo:

  • Sistemas com LLMs
  • Agentes inteligentes
  • Automação de atendimento
  • Plataformas escaláveis de dados

Detalhes da Vaga

AI QA Engineer (Pleno) | 1STi

Local: Híbrido — Rio de Janeiro (RJ)

Tipo: PJ

Oportunidade

Estamos buscando um(a) AI QA Engineer para atuar em um projeto estratégico envolvendo IA generativa em produção .

Essa não é uma vaga de QA tradicional.

Você será responsável por garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e segurança de sistemas baseados em LLMs e agentes , trabalhando lado a lado com times de engenharia e arquitetura.

QA significa testar comportamento de IA , não apenas código.

O que você vai fazer

  • Avaliar qualidade e coerência de outputs de LLMs
  • Testar guardrails de segurança e políticas de comportamento
  • Analisar logs, traces e métricas (Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry)
  • Validar pipelines RAG (retrieval + resposta)
  • Testar agentes inteligentes (roteamento, tools, memória)
  • Desenvolver automação de testes em Python
  • Explorar edge cases: alucinações, prompt injection, jailbreaks
  • Estruturar testes e comunicar métricas de qualidade

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência com QA ou testes
  • Python para automação
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (ex: pytest)
  • Capacidade analítica para investigação de logs e métricas
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos

title: Advogado(a) Sr.
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR) .

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do Custo Total de Propriedade (TCO) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Advogado(a) abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:

Sua missão

Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos de diversas naturezas (cíveis, comerciais, prestação de serviços e parcerias); atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas internas, oferecendo suporte jurídico estratégico; identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos com soluções preventivas e eficientes; promover ética e integridade por meio do desenvolvimento e gestão de programas de Compliance (políticas, códigos de conduta e treinamentos); apoiar investigações internas e a gestão do canal de denúncias; participar da estruturação de operações e projetos, garantindo conformidade legal e segurança jurídica; gerenciar demandas jurídicas com organização e priorização; apoiar a padronização e melhoria de processos do jurídico; interagir com escritórios externos e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Direito com registro ativo na OAB | Pós Graduação ou especialização em Direito Empresarial, Contratual ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial;
  • Experiência sólida em departamentos jurídicos de empresas | Vivência comprovada na análise, elaboração e negociação de contratos;
  • Inglês e espanhol intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office e familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão jurídica (diferencial).

Vantagens/Benefícios

  • Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
  • Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.
  • Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.

description:
Tech Lead (Especialista em Automação) – Qualicorp – Home Office

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesta posição você será responsável por:

  • Arquitetar Agentes de IA: Projetar e implementar agentes autônomos e chatbots inteligentes utilizando LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) e frameworks modernos.
  • Automação End-to-End: Utilizar N8N para orquestrar fluxos de trabalho complexos, integrando sistemas internos, APIs de terceiros e bancos de dados.
  • Implementar RAG: Desenvolver sistemas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation para que nossas IAs respondam com base em nossos documentos e dados proprietários.
  • Caçar Oportunidades: Atuar consultivamente junto às áreas de negócio para identificar processos repetitivos que podem ser otimizados ou extintos com IA.
  • Monitoramento e Escala: Garantir que os robôs e modelos estejam rodando com eficiência, custo controlado e segurança de dados (foco em LGPD).

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiências desejadas:

  • IA Generativa e LLMs: Experiência comprovada no uso de APIs de LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic etc.) e engenharia de prompt (Prompt Engineering).
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Vivência na implementação de arquiteturas RAG e conhecimento em bancos de dados vetoriais.
  • Agentes IA: Experiência comprovada na criação de agentes utilizando IA Generativa, integrando com WhatsApp, web chats etc.
  • Automação e Integração: Experiência prática e avançada com N8N (foco principal) ou ferramentas similares (Make/Zapier), incluindo consumo e criação de APIs (REST/JSON).
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados.
  • Linguagens de Programação: Familiaridade com linguagens como Python e JavaScript.

Diferenciais:

  • Setor de Saúde/Benefícios: Experiência prévia atuando com dados ou processos neste segmento.
  • Machine Learning Clássico: Conhecimento das bibliotecas padrão de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn) para resolução de problemas preditivos ou de classificação quando necessário.
  • Fine-tuning: Experiência no ajuste fino de modelos de linguagem para domínios específicos.

Habilidades e Comportamentos que fazem a diferença:

  • Visão de Negócio: Capacidade de olhar para um processo burocrático e enxergar onde a IA pode gerar valor real e economia de tempo.
  • Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil “mão na massa” (hands‑on) que não apenas executa demandas, mas investiga e propõe novas soluções inovadoras.
  • Adaptabilidade: Conforto em trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, onde as tecnologias (especialmente em IA) mudam muito rápido.
  • Comunicação Clara: Habilidade para documentar processos técnicos e explicar soluções complexas para stakeholders não técnicos.
  • Paixão por Inovação: Curiosidade genuína para testar novas ferramentas e acompanhar o “hype” tecnológico com olhar crítico e aplicável.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance and provides assistance for all activities planned by the project including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects including Regional Main, Minority AIDS Initiative, Inter-Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and others as appropriate.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor, evaluate, and record training activities and program effectiveness. Set up and coordinate HIV-related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills.
  • Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals, guides, and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organize and facilitate monthly video conference calls, in-person or online meetings, and training events. Present information using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos, and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize, and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishments. Monitor training costs to ensure the budget is not exceeded, prepare budget reports to justify expenditures, and select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Facilitate training at all levels on topics of relevance to the school or department, including the creation of training and education for the program.
  • Work with subcontractors to ensure the programs are developed, identify training needs, and effectively reach the targeted audience and enhance the quality of education.
  • Manage the certification process for continuing education credits for designated professions.
  • Increase the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community-based organizations, professional schools, and state and local government agencies.
  • Participate in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Support the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining, and providing appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintain files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and help organize all required documentation to and from our funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meet Program Quarterly goals and create reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training, and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community-based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on project outcomes and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities into the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers and related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access).
  • Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
  • Detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students, and the general public. Knowledge of creating and managing contracts for vendors, data entry, spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work independently to assist in paperwork for processing of grant funds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in business or administration and 3-6 years of experience. Five years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$42,000-52,000

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Receber os pacientes com empatia, cordialidade e atenção desde a chegada à clínica;
  • Realizar o acolhimento inicial, identificando necessidades e oferecendo suporte personalizado;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos, horários, documentos e fluxo da clínica;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre consultas, exames, encaminhamentos e demais serviços;
  • Realizar autorização de guias junto a operadoras de saúde (via sistemas como TISS ou plataformas específicas);
  • Efetuar o recebimento de atendimentos particulares, incluindo emissão de recibos e controle de pagamentos;
  • Acompanhar o paciente durante sua jornada, garantindo conforto e tranquilidade;
  • Após a consulta, verificar como foi a experiência e oferecer suporte adicional, se necessário;
  • Atuar como ponte entre paciente e equipe médica/administrativa, promovendo comunicação clara;
  • Receber e organizar documentos, correspondências e resultados de exames;
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas como preenchimento de fichas, arquivamento e atualização de cadastros;
  • Manter a recepção limpa, organizada e funcional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo (superior em áreas da saúde, humanas ou hospitalidade é um diferencial);
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escuta ativa;
  • Postura acolhedora, empática e proativa;
  • Experiência com atendimento ao público, preferencialmente em ambientes de saúde;
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações delicadas com sensibilidade e discrição.
  • Diferenciais:
  • Experiência com atendimento humanizado;
  • Conhecimento do sistema Tasy;
  • Conhecimento básico em sistemas de gestão ambulatorial;
  • Participação em treinamentos de hospitalidade ou experiência do cliente.

  • Plano Odontológico (sem desconto em folha)

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

description: Location: Brazil Team: Digital / Web Company Description Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. title: Especialista Em Estratégia E Gestão De Portfólio I

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta. Domínio do Office 365 (Excel, Power BI, Sharepoint e correlatos). Experiência no Setor de Energia, em especial Geração e Transmissão. Diferenciais Conhecimento em ferramentas associadas a Gestão de Portfolio. Experiência em gestão de CAPEX ou portfólio de investimentos. Conhecimento em boas práticas de gestão de projetos (PMI). title: Ai Engineer
description:
Company Description MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and a global leader in innovative IT solutions, with offices in London, UK, and a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in transformative, future-ready solutions, including Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud and database technologies. Backed by over 45+ technology experts and led by visionary leadership, MillionLogics delivers tailored and results-driven technology solutions. Committed to empowering organizations worldwide, the company embraces innovation and excellence to drive digital transformation. To learn more, visit: millionlogics.Com. Role Overview We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Offer Details : Contract Duration : 12 months Pay : US $200 (take-home) per task Experience : 3+ years Positions : 98 Work Mode : Remote Key Responsibilities Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the following;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualification: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Nice to Have Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. How to Apply: Please send us your updated CV to with Job ID- 72123 as your email subject.

title: Brazil : Remote: Tech Lead

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Llm Scientist
description: We are looking for an\ "LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing. Key Responsibilities Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters. Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy. Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency. Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers. Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets. Qualification Required Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate). Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures. Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models. Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al). Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions. Nice to Have Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP. Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration. Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization). Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space. Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization. About Our Client Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations. Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities Business Requirements & Client Engagement - Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies. Solution Design, Implementation & Testing - Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption. Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%) - Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. Must Have - Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer - Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Advogado(A) Sr.
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Advogado(a) Sr. abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Sua missão: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos de diversas naturezas (cíveis, comerciais, prestação de serviços e parcerias);
atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas internas, oferecendo suporte jurídico estratégico;

apoiar investigações internas e a gestão do canal de denúncias;
participar da estruturação de operações e projetos, garantindo conformidade legal e segurança jurídica;
gerenciar demandas jurídicas com organização e priorização;
apoiar a padronização emelhoria de processos do jurídico;

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Arquiteto De Soluções - Com Foco Em Ia
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: No Grupo Fleury, acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio. Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você. Principais desafios da posição: - Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente.

- Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Software ou Arquiteto de Plataforma.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization. Key Responsibilities Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process. Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures. Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems. Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.
